note: Quorum labels were committed before the 2023Q2-Q4 outcome files were read in this experiment.
interpretation: The source-quorum hypothesis did not replicate out of sample.
High-quality evidence improved confidence that the economic story and company exposure were real, but did not make the entry timing good.
The 2023 quorum-pass failures (Spring Airlines, Huadian International, BYD) are examples where strong official/company/research evidence still did not translate into 60d excess returns.
The only quorum-pass 60d winner was Innolight; the large positive mean is therefore dominated by one outlier.
Do not promote source quorum into a buy/Primary gate based on the 2025 retrospective result.
